name: VOIP_AUDIT_ACTIONS
description: The audited actions for VoIP call logs.

columns.name: VIDEO_VISIT_ID
columns.description: The unique identifier (.1 item) for the video visit record.

columns.name: LINE
columns.description: The line number for the information associated with this record. Multiple pieces of information can be associated with this record.

columns.name: VOIP_AUDIT_ACTION_C_NAME
columns.description: The single audit action for a VoIP call log.

columns.name: PARTICIPANT_GUID
columns.description: This item stores the participant GUIDs of each participant connected to the call.

columns.name: VOIP_USER_ID
columns.description: This item stores the EMP ID associated with the participant in the call.

columns.name: VOIP_USER_ID_NAME
columns.description: The name of the user record. This name may be hidden.

columns.name: VOIP_ACTION_INST_DTTM
columns.description: The instant of the audit action.

columns.name: DID_NOT_CONN_RSN_C_NAME
columns.description: The reason the participant did not connect to the call.

columns.name: ADD_BY_PARTICIPANT_GUID
columns.description: The participant GUID of the participant that added the participant to the call.

columns.name: VOIP_CLIENT_APP_TARGET_C_NAME
columns.description: This item stores the Epic application used to make/receive the call for the participant.

columns.name: VOIP_PHONE_NUMBER
